title: MathEvidence input v1
description: Domain evidence payload for the Math adapter's validate_claim. The kind enum separates certificate-class evidence (proof_certificate, formal_verification) from computational evidence (numeric_check, symbolic_check, random_sampling): only certificate-class evidence can lift a mathematical_claim to mathematically_verified (ADR-0005 decision 4).

kind.description: Evidence channel. Certificate class: proof_certificate, formal_verification. Everything else is non-certificate for maturity-ceiling purposes.

content_sha256.description: Hash of the evidence content itself (certificate bytes, computation log, dataset).

limitations.description: Known limitations of this evidence. Required; explicit empty array only after consideration.
